scope: Only the specifically authorized actor session UUID was inspected. Extract excludes system instructions, conversation text, unrelated shell commands, and image payload bytes.

finalMatrixCoverage.construction: The preserved script contains every PNG in each case directory, at most nine per sheet, in 480 x 300 cells with labels. All 18 matrix case directories contain at most nine originals and their corresponding -0 sheets have returned image blocks.

conclusion: Absence of view_image events in the exec --json stream is not evidence of absent visual inspection. The underlying actor session proves image-returning tool calls, including all 18 final matrix contact sheets representing all 93 matrix screenshots.
limits: Tool delivery establishes that images entered model context, not attention or visual judgment quality.
Contact sheets downsample each original to fit 480 x 300 pixels, so full-resolution legibility of all originals is not established.
This audit maps the preserved generator and case inventories; it does not rerun the contact-sheet generator or independently review every source image.
Raw judge output and frozen run artifacts were not changed.
